verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only narrow, glancing export paths: Snyk issues can be tracked and exported to Jira, and the snyk-to-html plugin generates local reports from CLI results. Nothing documents a complete account or organization export, or export in open machine-readable formats. Missing for 10: full-account/org data export, documented open formats (e.g. JSON/SARIF/CSV) for all projects, issues and settings, a documented offboarding/migration path, independent corroboration.
